input.sql: SELECT s.sehir, m.musteri_id, m.ad, m.tc_kimlik, m.kiraci AS musteri_kiraci, COUNT(i.islem_id) AS islem_sayisi, SUM(i.tutar) AS tutar_sum, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT i.durum, ',') AS durumlar, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT i.kiraci, ',') AS islem_kiraci FROM smoke.islemler i JOIN smoke.musteriler m ON i.musteri_id = m.musteri_id JOIN smoke.subeler s ON m.sube_kodu = s.sube_kodu GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY s.sehir, m.musteri_id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM smoke.islemler) AS islem_rows, (SELECT SUM(tutar) FROM smoke.islemler) AS islem_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM smoke.musteriler) AS musteri_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM smoke.islemler i LEFT JOIN smoke.musteriler m ON i.musteri_id=m.musteri_id WHERE m.musteri_id IS NULL) AS orphan_islem
SELECT islem_id, musteri_id, tutar, durum FROM smoke.islemler ORDER BY islem_id
